answer: Whether agents trade orchard harvests, reserve jetty berths, or buy oasis water, their market can weight governance votes by escrowed stake rather than account count. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand identities still yields only 100 tokens of voting weight. To gain control, an attacker must acquire and lock enough stake to outweigh honest participants, tying up real capital for the escrow period instead of cheaply multiplying accounts.
